scenario: a failed CommonJS replacement temporarily requires a dependency that the prior generation accepted but never imported
steps: The loaded dep.cjs generation registered module.hot.accept('./ghost.cjs') but had no require edge to ghost.cjs.
A replacement generation required ghost.cjs and then threw; Quench reported the failure and retained the prior dep.cjs generation.
ghost.cjs was edited after rollback. The old generation's acceptance callback was not invoked for the failed generation's transient edge.
The detached ghost module caused conservative restart fallback; startup then exited because dep.cjs still contained the intentionally throwing disk version.
result: Rollback restored the old importer edge set instead of retaining dependency edges recorded by failed evaluation.
scope: Focused rollback behavior check on one macOS host; the final exit is expected fallback against deliberately failing on-disk source.
